rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural edit instead of another scalar sweep. The tail anchor path and the recurrent block refresh no longer share the same curriculum: carry-to-anchor turns on a bit earlier, while the extra recurrent block update is delayed. That spends late-phase capacity on stabilizing the tail state before asking the shared tail blocks to rewrite it, which matches the local signal around anchor-refresh and staged recurrence while keeping shapes, eval, quantization, and the 600s MLX path unchanged. I also removed no functionality and kept the script under the 1500-line cap.
title: Staggered Tail Carry And Update Curriculum
